title: 78쪽 · 3x EP2 Open — BB Defense
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: To reinforce my argument above, Snowie is flatting almost its entire range against EP2 opens. It’s extremely polarized between A-A/A-Qs+ and random bluffs — most of which have blockers. So again, if the early Position opener is someone who habitually folds hands like J-J/10-10/A-Q to big blind 3-bets, it doesn’t make sense to 3-bet with Q-Q+ for value.

instead, you should flat your whole range and allow Villain to value-own himself with these hands post-flop. Keep In mind that you must resist the urge to check-raise big pairs on dry boards. You're sacrificing value by denying Villain an opportunity to bluff again on blank turns.
